results.note: reason: short id sliced from the wrong end -- last 8 chars instead of the first 8, so labels no longer match the id prefix users see.
reason: default mode for a channel with no options becomes an id mode, so unconfigured channels start emitting ids.
reason: the never short-circuit widened to swallow auto-id, killing identity on the whole auto-id mode.
reason: unnormalizable agent context no longer suppressed, so a label like 'None/a7c41e0b' can render.
reason: id membership narrowed to the literal 'id' mode, so auto-id drops the id for typed agents.
reason: _tool_label returns None whenever identity is None, so never-mode and auto-repeat tool entries fall back to the baked always string.
reason: full-id bracket suffix leaks onto ordinary agent body lines instead of appearing once on the start/stop bracket.
reason: full agent id baked into the legacy tool label instead of the 8-char short form (untyped bucket included).
reason: sentinel template baked only for non-agent entries, so agent tool entries have no template for the formatter to fill under the id modes.
reason: labelled summary template used only when it lacks the snippet marker, i.e. never -- templated tool entries silently keep the always-mode label.
reason: id suffix folded in before truncation, so a long bracket line truncates the id away instead of always ending with it.
reason: an explicit null override selects an id mode instead of resetting the channel to always.
